title: 2nd Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/2/3/2025).

Written question by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to Minister of Health Abdulla Nazim Ibrahim: why did the government decide to run an eyeglasses business itself instead of regulating how Aasandha provides spectacles, what did it cost to open the government optical shop, and what will it cost to run each year?

Written question by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to Minister of Health Abdulla Nazim Ibrahim: before the government suddenly entered the long-standing private eyeglasses trade, how far did it study the challenges this would cause those businesses, and what were the findings?

Written question by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to Minister of Homeland Security and Technology Ali Ihusan: the minutes of the first National Drug Control Council meeting on 4 June 2024 record that national drug policies would be completed; when does the ministry estimate that work will be finished?
Written question by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to Minister of Homeland Security and Technology Ali Ihusan: how far has drafting the national drug policy progressed, and what is its deadline?

Written question by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to Minister of Homeland Security and Technology Ali Ihusan: National Drug Agency board regulations require its CEO to hold a degree, yet an acting CEO with no legal knowledge or experience has served nearly 2 years; why has a CEO not been appointed as the law requires?
From the Speaker's desk: under Article 272(c) of the Standing Orders, a proposal to add a new chapter after Chapter 51 of Parliament's Standing Orders is sent to the relevant standing committee.
From the Speaker's desk: under Article 272(c) of the Standing Orders, a proposal to amend Article 61 of Parliament's Standing Orders is sent to the relevant standing committee.
From the Speaker's desk: Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim's proposal to amend Articles 75 and 76 of Parliament's Standing Orders is sent to the relevant standing committee.
First reading of Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim's bill amending the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives.
Preliminary debate on Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim's bill amending Law No. 5/2009 (Land Transport Act).
Continued debate on the Re-employment Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Guraidhoo MP Hanaan Mohamed Rasheed.

Continued debate on the resolution submitted by Madaveli MP Mohamed Shameez calling for the corruption flagged in the Auditor General's special audit report on Fenaka Corporation Limited to be investigated and acted on quickly.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting put written questions on the government optical shop and drug policy, sent three Standing Orders changes to committee, introduced a constitutional amendment bill, opened the Land Transport Act debate, and continued the Re-employment Bill and Fenaka resolution.
